note: Set A correctly associates most structural members with their respective details (e.g., HSS in C5/A4, C8 in C5), whereas Set B frequently misbinds members to the wrong details (assigning L3/L4 angles to C5 which uses HSS/W10, assigning C5 plates to Module Link). Set A has some duplicate claims and misinterprets a scale as spacing, but Set B contains pervasive binding errors regarding which detail contains which component. Set A also captures revision data accurately.
